title: Isaac in Gerar and the Covenant with Abimelech
description: During a famine, Isaac goes to Gerar, where he says out of fear that Rebekah is his sister. Abimelech discovers the lie and protects them. The Lord blesses Isaac with great wealth, but the Philistines become jealous and fill in his wells. After disputes over new wells, Isaac goes to Beersheba, where the Lord appears to him. Finally, Abimelech comes and makes a peace covenant with Isaac.
